background_story: Gabriella was a renowned botanist with a passion for the Centrospermae, a subclass of flowering plants. Her fascination with the unique characteristics of these plants, such as the presence of betalains, led her to dedicate her career to studying them. Gabriella spent years researching the diverse species within the Centrospermae, from the vibrant bougainvillea to the delicate portulaca. Her groundbreaking work on the phylogenetics of the group shed new light on the evolutionary relationships between these plants. As a leading expert in her field, Gabriella was invited to speak at conferences worldwide, sharing her knowledge with fellow botanists and inspiring a new generation of researchers. Her love for the Centrospermae had taken her on a journey of discovery, and she continued to uncover the secrets of these fascinating plants.
